input:
The negation of the statement (p ^ q) -> (~p v r) is

Options:
A. p v q v ~r
B. p ^ q ^ ~r
C. ~p v q ^ r
D. ~p v ~q v ~r

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Find the logical negation of an implication involving conjunction and disjunction.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Apply negation of implication, then simplify the negated disjunction.
logical_steps: Step 1: Let A=(p^q), B=(~p v r)
Step 3: Apply De Morgan to ~(~p v r)

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: Using ~ (A->B)=A^~B and De Morgan gives p^q^~r exactly.
